chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar from al-Hajjal from Ali ibn Shajara from Abu al-Wafa' al-Muradi from Sadir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
The one who loves to walk the walk of the Honourable Recorders (Angels), so let him walk by the side of the coffin.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to walk during a funeral procession to emulate the angels?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) links the physical etiquette of funeral processions to spiritual emulation, instructing believers to walk beside the coffin to mirror the dignified gait of the Kiram al-Katibin (the noble recording angels). This hadith, found in al-Kafi, underscores the profound respect due to the deceased and transforms a social ritual into an act of spiritual alignment with the celestial realm.
